newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar stays firm, nearby spread active.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar stays firm, nearby spread active.

text.p: London white sugar futures were content to stay tightly mixed in solid turnover on Tuesday as the approaching March expiry prompted continued against actuals and switch trades.
Although light trade buying was noted throughout the day, commission houses dominated the latter part of the session with March/May trades between $1.20 and $1.40, market sources said.
The overall volume wasboosted by some 600 lots of March/May and over 500 lots in AA trades, some of which were crossed.
At 1642 GMT March was still hovering around the psychological $300.00 level, standing 30 cents firmer at $299.90. May was up 10 cents at $298.50 and volume totalled 2,867 lots.
Traders said they expected an orderly March expiry next week with little chance of a squeeze on shorts as players roll spot positions forward and against actuals trades remain a steady feature.
Poland is again expected to feature as an origin in the physical deliveries.
In physical news, traders said Iran bought at least two cargoes of raw sugar at its recent tender and probably one cargo of white sugar as well.
Pakistan was said to have bought up to four cargoes of whites last week and results were still awaited in Sri Lanka's recent tender to buy an April cargo of 100 ICUMSA whites.
The Paris market was also tightly mixed. March was up 20 cents at $299.50 and May down 50 cents at $298.00. Matif volume was a light 708 lots.
